annotation.interpretation_a: The implementation may choose not to send the Last-Modified value.
annotation.interpretation_b: The implementation is encouraged to send the Last-Modified value, but may omit it under certain circumstances.
annotation.justification: The use of 'SHOULD' introduces a degree of discretion. While it indicates a recommendation, it doesn't definitively mandate sending the Last-Modified value, leaving room for different implementations. A concrete constraint specifying conditions under which it *must* be sent would remove the ambiguity.
